## unity collaboration

- CLI version: `1.0.0-beta.9`
- Supported platforms: linux, macos, windows
- Aliases: `collab`

Manage Unity Collaboration resources (annotations, attachments, Jira,

reactions). Not version control; see unity vcs.

### Usage

`unity collaboration|collab [options] [command]`

### Subcommands

| --- | --- | --- |

| `reactions` | — | Manage emoji reactions on annotation threads |
